# Scrap Machine
<!-- generated by tools/wiki_tables.py, do not edit -->

*Put items inside and fuel it with a Petrol Can, it breaks them down into Scrap Metal.*

| Property | Value |
|:--|:--|
| Size | 12 |
| Category | Other item |
| Hit points | 12 |

## Where to find it

Not found as loot.

- Already built in the world: 1 (1 in Flint County).
- Crafted, see below.

## Crafting

**Made by**

- On the ground with a [Screwdriver](Screwdriver) (kept), 30 s: [Gas Cylinder](Gas-Cylinder) + [Fluctuator Unit](Fluctuator-Unit) + [Motor](Motor) + [Power Supply](Power-Supply); taken down again with a [Crowbar](Crowbar) in 25 s, which gives the parts back

## Scrap

Cannot be scrapped: a Scrap Machine destroys it, see [Scrap](Scrap).
